title: Red Hat Security Advisory: vim security, bug fix, and enhancement update
description: A security vulnerability in Vim (Vi IMproved) allows arbitrary code execution due to a Vimscript injection via an unescaped filename in the netrw s:NetrwMarkFile() filter() expression. This issue is tracked as CVE-2026-43961 and affects Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.8 Extended Update Support versions. Red Hat has released an update addressing this vulnerability along with other bug fixes and enhancements.
